boxes.text: Takes list of 2 floats (x,y) and outputs the interpolated weight of each node at that position.

Output: 
Left outlet is a list of interpolation weights.  

Middle outlet reports node positions and sizes in the form [query, node number, x-position, y-position, size] with various 'get' messages such as "getxy" or "getsize". These lists can be parsed for use in other contexts (see dump-get subpatcher). 

Right outlet reports mousing information inside the nodes patching rectangle.

Click and drag the cross to position the slider.
Click and drag center of node to position a node.
Option Key enables resizing of node with mousedrag.

Pattrstorage supports the recall of multiple presets at the same time, using decimal values as weights. This allows for smooth transitions between multiple stored patcher states. Try moving the knob around in the nodes object above and watch the UI update.
Nodes list output works well with "recallmulti" messages, providing a powerful way to morph between different presets.
multiplying by 0.9999 makes sure that the value never reaches 1. when you are exactly at the center of a node (which would cause recallmulti to recall the next preset)

shift-click to add a new preset in slot 6 and observe that a new node is added

connecting a nodes object to a preset object enables dynamic mode where a node is automatically created for each preset slot (up to the current value of the maxdynamicnodes attribute). To disable this behavior, turn off the dynamic attribute. As with pattrstorage, nodes sends the preset object the recallmulti message to perform the interpolation of preset states.
